titulo: JMGO’s very bright all-in-one projector looks ideal for gamers and sports
cuerpo: JMGO's 4K 120Hz Iris Ultra Max all-in-one Google TV projector is now available outside China. It gets its name from a new dual-iris system that lets it produce an impressive 10,000:1 native contrast, according to JMGO.
